Per membership/comfort_club_overview.md, Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling ahead of non-members, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, annual reminder and filter-change notifications, and $500 off any full system replacement.
Standard is $189 per year or $16.99 per month, and Plus is $269 per year and adds a water heater flush and inspection, a whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
